verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a software install path: no pip/PyPI package, no Homebrew or other package manager, and no prebuilt release binaries. The `.venv/bin/python scripts/...` usage suggests running from a repo checkout. The single-download 'ready-to-run' bundles are model weights, not the software itself, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit. The listed platform apps (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS) are never described as distributed prebuilt, so the axis applies but no delivery is evidenced.
